tagline: Turn your GitHub commits into per-project weekly summaries, a weekly coding recap, and a ready-to-film Instagram Reel script.
summary: Code Commit Summaries syncs repositories and commits from the GitHub owners you allow into local Postgres, then uses AI to explain what you actually built. On a project's page you generate a project code week summary for a date range; the Coding Summary hub combines the overlapping project summaries into one weekly coding summary with a period recap, a feature/topic inventory and a short video script that's broken into Instagram Reel shots.

Projects aren't defined here anymore. Since the Code Control cutover, project names, descriptions and repo lists come from Code Control's software systems (through the studio gateway); this app stores only the operational data — commits, summaries, overviews — keyed by `software_system_id`. Data lives either in local Postgres or, in remote mode, behind a storage Express on the studio machine.
audience: You commit across many repos and orgs and want a weekly narrative of what changed without reading `git log`.
You post build-in-public content and want a script and shot list generated from real commits.
You already run Code Control (and ideally the studio gateway) as the catalog of your software systems.
notFor: Team analytics or productivity metrics — it summarizes one author's commits (`GITHUB_DEFAULT_AUTHOR`).
GitLab or Bitbucket — GitHub only, through a classic PAT.
Managing projects by itself — local `content_project` CRUD returns 403; projects are managed in Code Control.

capabilities.title: GitHub catalog
capabilities.detail: `/repos` and `/sources` sync orgs, repos and README text from `GITHUB_ALLOWED_OWNERS` into Postgres (`POST /api/github/repos/sync`).

capabilities.title: Commit browser
capabilities.detail: `/commits` and `/commit-detail-page` list stored commits per repo and date window.

capabilities.title: Projects from Code Control
capabilities.detail: `/projects` lists software systems from Code Control with commit counts; a sync modal links, creates or skips unlinked projects.

capabilities.title: Project week summaries
capabilities.detail: On `/project-detail-page`, generate a summary of a project's commits for a date range (Anthropic). Opens in `/project-summary-detail-page`.

capabilities.title: Weekly coding summary
capabilities.detail: `/coding-summary` → **New script run** combines completed project summaries into a period recap, a feature inventory (stats from stored commits, not the model) and a video script (Gemini).

capabilities.title: Instagram Reel plan
capabilities.detail: Each weekly summary gets a shot list capped at 70s (`instagram_reel` / `instagram_reel_shot`); **Regenerate from script** rebuilds it.

capabilities.title: Doc-backed project overview
capabilities.detail: `/project-overview-detail-page` synthesizes READMEs, getting-started docs and landing page source into one product narrative.

capabilities.title: AI prompts and costs
capabilities.detail: `/ai-prompts` edits the prompt per AI flow; `/ai-costs` shows the exchange ledger (tokens and cost per call).

components.name: Web app
components.owns: Landing page, dashboard and all screens. Next.js API routes under `src/app/api/*` proxy to Express and add `SERVICES_API_KEY` server-side.

components.name: API
components.stack: Express + TypeScript, `pg`, Anthropic SDK, Google Generative AI
components.owns: GitHub sync, summary generation (Anthropic per project, Gemini for weekly scripts), reel shot building, the public API, and the Code Control gateway calls. `/api/*` is gated by `SERVICES_API_KEY` when set.
components.doesNotOwn: Project identity (Code Control). In remote mode it doesn't touch Postgres directly.

components.name: Storage server
components.runsOn: The machine that owns the `commit_summaries` Postgres (port 3079), usually the studio, reached through the on-device dispatcher
components.owns: Canonical CRUD via `POST /api/storage/v1/invoke`, migrations, seed export/import, and the dispatcher exposed-endpoints list.
components.doesNotOwn: GitHub, AI or HTTP for the browser.

dataFlow: Express syncs repos and commits from GitHub with `GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` (scopes `repo` + `read:org`) and stores them.
Storage is either local (`DATABASE_URL` → `commit_summaries`) or remote (`STORAGE_MODE=remote` → `STORAGE_EXPRESS_URL`, usually the studio gateway with `DISPATCHER_GATE_SECRET`).
Project lists come from Code Control through `MAIN_GATEWAY_URL` (`getAllSoftwareSystems`, `getAllSoftwareSystemRepos`).
Generating a project summary sends that project's commits to Anthropic; each call is logged to an exchanges table with its cost.
A weekly script run sends the overlapping project summaries to Gemini, then builds the reel shots in code.
The browser only talks to Next.js API routes, which proxy to Express.

trust.title: Browser
trust.detail: Talks only to Next.js routes. `SERVICES_API_KEY` is added server-side and never shipped to the client.

trust.title: Express (your machine)
trust.detail: Holds the GitHub PAT, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY` and the gateway secret.

trust.title: Storage host
trust.detail: The only place with `DATABASE_URL` in remote mode; accepts calls carrying the shared storage/dispatcher secret.

trust.title: GitHub / Anthropic / Google
trust.detail: Commit messages and diffs-derived text are sent to the AI providers when you generate summaries.

commonTasks.title: First-time setup (local storage)
steps: Open the **Storage Express** repo → **Set up local database** to create `commit_summaries` and apply `migrations/`.
In the API's **Environment** step set `GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_ALLOWED_OWNERS`, `GITHUB_DEFAULT_AUTHOR`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY` and `DATABASE_URL`.
Make sure `SERVICES_API_KEY` matches on web and API (or leave both empty locally).
Press **Run**, open the web app and sync repos from `/sources`.

commonTasks.title: Use the studio's storage (remote mode)
commonTasks.when: The canonical database lives on the studio machine.
steps: Pick the **remote** data plane in the API's Environment step (`STORAGE_MODE=remote`).
Set `STORAGE_EXPRESS_URL` to the studio gateway (e.g. `http://<studio-ip>:3010/code-commit-summaries`) and `DISPATCHER_GATE_SECRET`.

commonTasks.title: Write this week's summary
steps: Open each active project on `/projects` and generate a project summary for the week.
Go to `/coding-summary` → **New script run** for the same range.
Open the run to read the recap, feature inventory and the **Instagram Reel** tab.

commonTasks.title: Link projects to Code Control
commonTasks.when: A software system is missing or `/projects` is empty.
steps: Open the sync modal on `/projects` and choose **Link**, **Create** or **Skip** for each unlinked project.
New projects should be created in Code Control itself.

commonTasks.title: Tune an AI prompt
commonTasks.when: Summaries are too long, too vague or off-tone.
steps: Open `/ai-prompts`, pick the flow (e.g. `summary_run_project`) and edit the prompt.
Regenerate, then check token cost in `/ai-costs`.

troubleshooting.symptom: Private repos or org repos are missing
troubleshooting.fix: The PAT needs `repo` + `read:org`, and SSO must be authorized for each org at github.com/settings/tokens. The owner must also be in `GITHUB_ALLOWED_OWNERS`.
Projects come from Code Control. Check `MAIN_GATEWAY_URL`, `DISPATCHER_GATE_SECRET` and that the studio gateway and Code Control are running.
`SERVICES_API_KEY` differs between the web `.env.local` and the API `.env`.
The studio dispatcher or storage server is asleep or unreachable. Hit `<gateway>/code-commit-summaries/api/storage/health`, or raise `STORAGE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS`.
Expected — local project CRUD is disabled after the Code Control cutover. Create the software system in Code Control.
Check `GEMINI_API_KEY` and `GEMINI_TWITTER_MODEL`, and that at least one completed project summary overlaps the chosen range.

glossary.definition: AI summary of one project's commits for a date range (`project_code_week_summary`).
A script run combining project summaries into a recap, feature inventory and video script.
Code Control's record of a product and its repos — the source of truth for projects here.
One logged AI call with prompt, response, tokens and cost.
`STORAGE_MODE=remote`: Express sends CRUD to the storage server instead of Postgres.

hubNotes: hub.local.json has no `storageExpressDir` for this project, even though `code-commit-summaries-storage-express-server` is cloned next to the other two — add it so Hub can run and configure storage.
The registry's database setup targets the storage repo (`envRepo: storage-express`); the API only needs `DATABASE_URL` in local mode.
Code Control sync depends on the studio gateway (port 3010) and the code-control project being up.
Both web and API READMEs are still the template's; the ADRs in `.cursor/architecture/` are the real docs.
